statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let smooth := fun n q : ℕ => ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ≤ (1+Nat.log 2 (Q n))^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => smooth n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ))/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)) ≤ ε

plain_statement.zh: 所有小素因子分母的加权总量趋零

brief.zh: 算术猜想，允许全部 (1+log₂ Q)⁸ 光滑分母。先用 q/Q 控制小分母，再尝试用 Rankin 界估计较大光滑数及其 1/φ(q) 权重。
brief.en: Allow every denominator whose prime factors are at most (1+log₂ Q)⁸. Use q/Q for small q and try a Rankin bound for the weighted smooth-number tail.
